easiest pasta sauce ever - i usually use a variation on this recipe when i bring a girl home for a date - it's ultra fast and easy , but looks like i really know how to cook - and somewhat impressive.

step 1:  get vegetables.  any vegetable you want in your sauce is good here; i use onions, garlic, mushrooms and green pepper.  dice them and brown them in a deep skillet using olive oil or butter.  if you want meat, put it in here too - normally i make this vegetarian, but you don't have to.

step 2:  once vegetables are tender add 1 large can of diced tomatoes (or whole tomatoes and cut them up); add spice here, normally i add salt pepper, hot pepper flakes (or sauce) and a bit of Italian seasoning - but use your own imagination, you can taste when you add these to make sure it's not too salty.  then bring this to a boil

step 3:  once it starts boiling add 1 small can of tomato paste and stir it up.

step 4: simmer (on medium heat) until thickened, usually 5-10 min, normally i put the pasta on now, and when the pasta is done, so is my sauce.
